mechanics.claim: The damage of Decimating Smash is calculated when it is released; gaining AD or upgrading the ability during its channel will update the damage of the coming hit.
mechanics.quote: The damage of ''Decimating Smash'' is calculated when it is released. Gaining {{as|AD}} or upgrading the ability during its channel will update the damage of the coming hit.

mechanics.claim: Sion is locked out of all actions for 0.25 seconds when releasing the recast, delaying his next action (e.g. an auto-attack).
mechanics.quote: '''Sion''' himself remains {{tip|lockout|locked out}} of all actions for {{fd|0.25}} seconds when releasing ''Decimating Smash''.

mechanics.claim: Decimating Smash can be recast within the channel duration, and automatically does so afterwards; the recast deals the hit's damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Decimating Smash'' can be recast within the duration, and automatically does so afterwards.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on release of the recast (post-effect), not when the channel begins.
